question: What helps in food digestion?
solution:
The correct answer is **Saliva**.

__
 
• **Saliva helps in food digestion**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• Saliva is a clear liquid made by the salivary glands in the mouth area.
 
• It is mostly made of water.
 
• Saliva also contains Mucus, white blood cells, epithelial cells, enzymes, antimicrobial agents.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
